work.title: Années de pèlerinage I: Suisse, S. 160

version.note: The track is identified as Au bord d’une source. The exact edition and inclusion or omission of Liszt’s optional later coda are not independently established; duration alone is not used to decide.

performers.note: This is a historical acoustic disc performance, not a reproducing-piano roll. Instrument make is unestablished.

date.note: The reissue scan gives 1912/3. The uploader’s filename says III.1913, a narrower date not independently corroborated; it is retained as an attribution rather than promoted to a verified session month.

place.note: The source does not establish the session venue.

label.note: Original acoustic disc followed by the named CD compilation; the selected upload supplies a digital copy of that reissue track.

catalogue.note: The compilation carries ©/℗1993. That is the reissue year, not the historical session or the upload date.

matrixTakeSides.note: Both upload filename and primary track-list scan agree. A take suffix and paired disc side are not established.

credits.note: No named transfer engineer is identified in the consulted item metadata and track-list scan. Symposium is the reissue label, not an automatically inferred engineering credit.

date.note: The upload date is not treated as a transfer date.

processing.value: Archive supplies a variable-bitrate MP3 derivative of an uploaded WAV.
processing.note: The compilation’s 1993 copyright date does not establish a digitisation date or a particular restoration procedure.

digital.format: Internet Archive variable-bitrate MP3 derivative of the uploaded WAV track, sourced from Symposium CD 1146

composition.value: Underlying composition is out of copyright where the ordinary life-plus-70 term applies.
composition.note: Liszt died in 1886. This is a term calculation, not worldwide clearance of every edition.

recording.value: Archive applies Public Domain Mark to the historical Odeon performance, dated 1912/3 by the reissue.
recording.note: The historical issue falls within the project’s US pre-1926 basis. The CD scan separately asserts 1993 compilation rights; those are not represented as a new recording date or as a licence grant. PDM is a status declaration, not worldwide legal clearance.
